sentences.text: You should never transgress the boundary of a deal once the ink is dry, for trust, once broken, can be slow to recover, and never sign under undue pressure or while you may chase an elusive guarantee.
sentences.translation: 一旦墨迹已干,你绝不应逾越协议的边界,因为信任一旦破裂,恢复起来会很慢;也绝不要在过度的压力下签字,也不要追逐一个难以捉摸的保证。

sentences.text: A wise mentor can review your point in advance and warn you about the oncoming question that is most difficult to answer, for preparation, after all, can remain the real secret of fluency.
sentences.translation: 一位明智的导师可以提前审阅你的要点,并提醒你即将到来的最难回答的问题;毕竟,准备才是流利的真正秘诀。

lessonGrammar.name: less... than... 比较结构
lessonGrammar.note: depend less on A than on B 表示"更多取决于 B 而非 A",是论证中权衡因素的标准句式。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Successful negotiation in the workplace can depend less on a loud voice than on the ability to express a position clearly and to listen with genuine patience.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 职场中的成功谈判,更多取决于清晰表达立场和真诚耐心倾听的能力,而非嗓门大小。

lessonGrammar.name: 不定式并列
lessonGrammar.note: to express a position clearly and to listen with genuine patience 两个不定式并列,说明能力的具体内容。

lessonGrammar.name: can 表可能性
lessonGrammar.note: can 表示"可能、能够",使观点留有分寸,语气客观。

lessonGrammar.name: Before 引导时间状语从句
lessonGrammar.note: Before the meeting can begin 交代准备动作的时机,是口语表达中交代先后顺序的常用结构。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Before the meeting can begin, you should prepare a lucid summary of your goal and rehearse it aloud until the sentence can flow without hesitation.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在会议开始之前,你应该准备一份关于目标的清晰摘要,并大声演练,直到句子能不假思索地流畅说出。

lessonGrammar.name: 并列谓语 should prepare... and rehearse...
lessonGrammar.note: 两个 should 后的并列动词短语提出两项准备任务。
